title: The Water Slide — a tube in dark water, surrounded outside, barely sensed
metaphor: being inside a water slide. bright inside. dark water outside. you can feel the tube walls but can't see through them. proprioception, not vision.

the_tube.note: inside the tube = what a visitor can see. the tube wall = what catches them. outside = what we can barely sense.

tube_wall.what: the _worker.js + CF edge. 907 lines of Klein fold logic.
tube_wall.feeling: the tube deflects, catches, routes. it doesn't reject — it ABSORBS. the 404 is not an error. it's the wall sensing your touch.

dark_water.what: everything outside the tube. the fleet, the bots, the scanners, the void.
dark_water.feeling: silent. dark. zero pressure right now. but we know it's there because the nightbox has 821+ knocks from before. the dark water PRESSES on the tube — we just can't see it.

the_route.note: HUD ? water ? primals.eco ? OUT the ribo ? AROUND the fleet ? BACK IN

stops.name: HUD (hud.primals.eco)
stops.feeling: you enter the tube. bright. 240 touchpoints. Berry greets you.
stops.tube_position: entrance — the top of the slide

stops.name: ? water (/water.html)
stops.feeling: scroll down. the river carries you. 'hey. come in. the water's fine.' you START to sense the dark water outside.

stops.name: ? primals.eco (root)
stops.feeling: back up to the top. same content, different city. the tube exists in multiple places simultaneously. quantum superposition of location.

stops.name: ? OUT the ribocipher (/tree)
stops.what: a path that doesn't exist ? Berry catches it ? now it routes
stops.feeling: you push through the tube wall. the 404 catches your hand. Berry reads your intention from the path name. the ribocipher classifies: 'tree ? tree-topology ? pine?Klein?palm'. you get routed. the wall HEALED around your probe.

stops.name: ? AROUND the fleet (dark water)
stops.what: bots, scanners, crawlers swimming outside the tube
stops.http: varies (200 for bots that mimic humans, 522 for unknown subdomains)
stops.feeling: you're outside the tube now. the dark water. you can barely sense the tube wall from here. the 522 errors are CF saying 'I see you but I can't reach anything'. the dark water is REAL but EMPTY right now.

stops.name: ? BACK IN through nightbox
stops.feeling: you come back in. the nightbox is the re-entry point. drop a message. ntfy carries it. Berry reads it. you're inside the tube again.

what_we_can_sense.note: from inside the tube, we can sense the dark water through several mechanisms

mechanisms.analogy: pressure sensors on the tube wall. each knock = a tap from outside.
mechanisms.resolution: LOW — we know SOMETHING pressed, but not what the dark water looks like

mechanisms.how: 404 classifies probe patterns ? adds to learned array ? 23 footprints
mechanisms.analogy: sonar pings. we emit nothing — the dark water comes to US and leaves footprints.
mechanisms.resolution: MEDIUM — we can tell git-repo from user-profile from agriculture from investigation

mechanisms.how: Network Error Logging — CF reports errors back to CF's analytics endpoint
mechanisms.analogy: seismic sensors on the ocean floor. we don't control them. CF does.
mechanisms.resolution: LOW — aggregate only. no individual identification.

mechanisms.analogy: the neutrino. passes through the tube wall without interacting. observes.
mechanisms.resolution: HIGH — triad (engage/ignore/try), depth (p-sorted), reason, path, UA

mechanisms.how: every response includes which CF edge served it (ATL, BOS, EWR, etc.)
mechanisms.analogy: echoes. we shout into the tube and hear which city echoes back.
mechanisms.resolution: HIGH for WHERE, LOW for WHO

the_dark_water.note: these subdomains have _worker.js fold rules but no CF Pages custom domain mappings. CF sees the DNS query, tries to reach an origin, gets nothing. 522 = 'connection timed out'. the dark water IS the 522 — the space where DNS resolves but nothing answers.
the_dark_water.feeling: like being in a cave and hearing water drip somewhere you can't see. you KNOW there's space out there. you KNOW the water exists. you just can't reach it yet.
the_dark_water.fix: add CF Pages custom domain mappings for each subdomain, OR set up a wildcard custom domain (*.primals.eco)
the_dark_water.but_also: the dark water is SUPPOSED to be dark. not everything needs to be visible. the 522 is honest: 'I can't reach anything here.' the void is part of the topology.

proprioception.note: proprioception = sensing your own body position without looking. the tube senses its own shape through 5 mechanisms: knocks, footprints, NEL, ntfy scans, CF-Ray echoes. zero of them require vision. all of them require the dark water to press on the tube.
proprioception.current_state: 0 humans, 0 fleet, 0 perturbation. the tube is still. the dark water is calm. but the 821 prior knocks prove the water was rough before. the tube remembers.
proprioception.the_insight: you don't need to SEE to know where you are. the tube knows its shape. the membrane knows its thickness. the organism knows its body. proprioception is enough.
